review: 701.3a-1: resolution decision named a choice that does not exist in the protected_host variant; reworded to choose Hill Giant only when it is a legal host.
701.3b-1: other_host expects Grafted Wargear's trigger to resolve but no decision passed priority for it; added the pass to the decisions.

scenarios.title: An Aura moved by an effect attaches only to a permanent it could enchant

setup.notes: Pacifism is attached to Grizzly Bears and controlled by B. Both libraries are non-empty and irrelevant.

decisions: A casts Aura Graft targeting Pacifism, tapping both Islands.

Both players pass; Aura Graft resolves: A gains control of Pacifism, then A attaches it to Hill Giant, the only other permanent Pacifism can enchant (in a variant with no such permanent, no choice is made).

variants.label: legal_host
variants.expected: A gains control of Pacifism. Pacifism moves from Grizzly Bears to Hill Giant: Hill Giant can't attack or block, Grizzly Bears can. Aura Graft resolved and is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: protected_host
variants.delta: A's other creature is Black Knight (protection from white) instead of Hill Giant.
variants.expected: A gains control of Pacifism, but a white Aura can't be attached to Black Knight, so Pacifism does not move: it stays attached to Grizzly Bears, which still can't attack or block. Black Knight is unaffected. Aura Graft resolved and is in A's graveyard.

scenarios.forge_notes: Aura Graft's Attach sub-ability uses Choices$ Permanent; confirm Forge filters the choice by what the Aura can enchant (including protection) so no illegal host is offered.

scenarios.title: An attach effect aimed at the permanent the Equipment is already attached to does nothing

setup.notes: Equip costs {0}, so no mana is needed. Both libraries are non-empty and irrelevant.

decisions: A activates Grafted Wargear's equip ability targeting Grizzly Bears (the creature it is already attached to).
Both players pass; the equip ability resolves. If a becomes-unattached trigger goes on the stack, both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: same_host
variants.expected: The equip effect does nothing: Grafted Wargear stays attached to Grizzly Bears (5/4), no becomes-unattached trigger fires, and Grizzly Bears is not sacrificed.

variants.label: other_host
variants.delta: The equip ability targets Hill Giant instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Grafted Wargear moves to Hill Giant (6/5). Its becomes-unattached trigger fires and Grizzly Bears is sacrificed, moving to A's graveyard.

scenarios.forge_notes: The rule's other branch, an object that is not an Aura, Equipment or Fortification being attached, needs a second effect that changes the object's types in response and has no simple card in Forge.

scenarios.title: Re-attaching an Equipment gives it a new timestamp

setup.notes: Swiftfoot Boots (equip {1}) is already attached to Grizzly Bears. Darksteel Mutation removes all abilities of its host and then gives it indestructible; Swiftfoot Boots gives its host haste and hexproof. Both effects act in the ability layer and are ordered by timestamp.

decisions: A casts Darksteel Mutation targeting Hill Giant, tapping two Plains; both players pass; it resolves and attaches to Hill Giant.
A activates equip on Swiftfoot Boots targeting Hill Giant, tapping the third Plains; both players pass; the equip ability resolves and Swiftfoot Boots moves from Grizzly Bears to Hill Giant.

variants.label: equip_after_aura
variants.expected: Swiftfoot Boots' new timestamp is later than Darksteel Mutation's, so Hill Giant is a 0/1 indestructible Insect artifact creature that has haste and hexproof. Grizzly Bears is an unequipped 2/2.

variants.label: equip_before_aura
variants.delta: The two actions swap order: A first activates equip (Swiftfoot Boots moves to Hill Giant), then casts Darksteel Mutation targeting Hill Giant.
variants.expected: Darksteel Mutation's timestamp is later than Swiftfoot Boots', so it removes the granted keywords: Hill Giant is a 0/1 indestructible Insect artifact creature with no haste and no hexproof.

scenarios.forge_notes: The layer-6 result in the continuous record is the only observable of the timestamp.

scenarios.title: An Equipment that stops being attached triggers its becomes-unattached ability

setup.notes: Grafted Wargear: whenever it becomes unattached from a permanent, sacrifice that permanent. Equip costs {0}.

decisions: A activates Grafted Wargear's equip ability targeting Hill Giant.
Both players pass; the equip ability resolves. The becomes-unattached trigger goes on the stack, both players pass, and it resolves.

variants.label: moved_away
variants.expected: Grafted Wargear moves from Grizzly Bears to Hill Giant (6/5). The becomes-unattached trigger fires for Grizzly Bears and Grizzly Bears is sacrificed, moving to A's graveyard.

variants.label: host_destroyed
variants.delta: Instead of equipping, A casts Doom Blade targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping both Swamps.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is destroyed and moves to A's graveyard. Grafted Wargear stays on the battlefield, unattached, and its becomes-unattached trigger fires; there is nothing left to sacrifice. Hill Giant stays 3/3.

variants.label: never_attached
variants.delta: Grafted Wargear starts unattached, and A equips it to Hill Giant.
variants.expected: Grafted Wargear attaches to Hill Giant (6/5). No becomes-unattached trigger fires and Grizzly Bears stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.forge_notes: Confirm Forge fires the Unattached trigger when the host leaves the battlefield (state-based unattach), not only when an equip ability moves the Equipment.
